title: WaitlistForm
spec_markdown:
Build a `WaitlistForm` component with:
- Controlled email input
- Submit button
- Validation: email must contain @
- Show an error message when invalid
- Call the `onJoin` prop with a valid email on submit
solution_explanation: 1) useState for email and error. 2) preventDefault on submit. 3) Simple @ validation. 4) Connect label to input with htmlFor/id for accessibility.
best_practices: Associate labels with inputs for accessibility
Do not mutate state directly — use the setter
learning_objective: Build a React form with validation and basic accessibility

title: ProductCard
spec_markdown:
Build a `ProductCard` that accepts props `name`, `price`, and `onAdd`.
- Display name and price
- An "Add" button calls onAdd when clicked
solution_explanation: Render name and price props and wire onClick to the onAdd callback.
best_practices: Presentational components receive data via props
common_mistakes: onAdd not called from the button
learning_objective: Presentational component with props and callbacks
